newsitem.title: SWEDEN: SCA buys UK tissue mill.
newsitem.headline: SCA buys UK tissue mill.

text.p: Swedish forestry group Svenska Cellulosa Aktiebolaget (SCA) said on Tuesday it bought the Prudhoe tissue mill from Kimberly-Clark in Britain. The plant has annual capacity of 80,000 tonnes.
In return Kimberly-Clark will take over SCA Molnlycke's nappy brand Peaudouce in France, SCA said in a statement.
SCA said turnover for the Prudhoe plant is estimated to be around 130 million pounds.
The deal is estimated to have a positive full-year effect of 1.20 crowns on SCA's earnings per share.
SCA said it had also decided to build a corrugated board plant at Linselles, France.
